title: Evolving Excellence: Automated Optimization of LLM-based Agents

mechanism.domainTask: Optimization of LLM-agent prompts, tools, model assignments and settings across coding and math benchmarks
mechanism.populationDetail: A multi-candidate configuration population is evolved in generations; Figure 2 describes an evolving search tree and the UI exposes lineage, but the tree's operational role is unclear.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No distinct elite archive, admission rule or size is specified despite discussion of successful candidates.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Generations and small population sizes are reported, but the exact survivor/replacement protocol and tree maintenance are not stated.
mechanism.generationDetail: LLM semantic mutation creates a new version of a source component, while crossover merges successful elements from different candidates; mutation scope and crossover arity are unspecified.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Benchmark outcomes and execution logs inform optimization, but the exact feedback packet supplied to each operator is not specified.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Mutation is unary and crossover merges different candidates, but parent choice, crossover arity and tree use are not stated.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Local semantic GA and global Bayesian combination search coexist as platform strategies; a maintained lineage tree is described without a clear control role.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/Evolving Excellence Automated Optimization of LLM-based Agents.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Current survey cites the paper only for workflow/application, not Chapters 3-7. Tree structure, survivor rules, archive logic, operator selection, model-ensemble invocation and parent selection require qualification; large-scale mutation is only an approximate section fit because edit scope is unstated.
